fields.Field Name (EN): ═══ return envelope - keyed in the operator portal, not in the detail file ═══

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Tipo y numero de documento del aportante
fields.Position (Start-End): Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
fields.Field Explanation: COMPOSITE FIELD. The employer authenticates to the information operator with the pair (document type, document number) plus a user document pair and a password; the contributor identity is then taken from the operator's registration record, not re-keyed per return. Composite Key: sub-field 1 = document type (NI for a legal person); sub-field 2 = the NIT without the check digit, without dots and without hyphens. PERSISTENCE: fixed for the life of the legal entity; it must be the SAME NIT used on the PILA return and on Form 350, because Simple S.A. offers to seed the severance savings return from the last PILA return paid for the selected year and the seed matches on this pair.

fields.Position (Start-End): Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
fields.Field Explanation: A constant for this filing. The operator portals treat severance savings as one of the Supplementary social-security payments (PCSS) services and it is selected explicitly; selecting the wrong service produces a PILA return, not a severance savings return.

fields.Field Name (EN): Accrual year of the severance savings
fields.Position (Start-End): Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
fields.Field Explanation: THE PERIOD OF THIS FILING IS A YEAR, NOT A MONTH. This is the single most important structural difference from every other Colombian payroll filing: the electronic payroll, Form 350 and PILA are monthly and keyed to a payment date, whereas the severance savings return is keyed to the accrual YEAR that closed on 31 December and is paid in the FOLLOWING February. A return built in February 2027 carries ano accrued = 2026.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Tipo de afiliacion de la planilla
fields.Position (Start-End): Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
fields.Field Explanation: Three values exist - Agremiado (contributions for associated or unionised independents), Dependiente (contributions arising from an employment contract, payroll-deducted) and Independiente (a natural person contributing for themselves). For an employer filing this return it is ALWAYS Dependiente. The values offered depend on the contributor type under which the employer registered on the platform.

fields.Position (Start-End): Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
fields.Field Explanation: Selected before the detail is loaded, because it changes the OUTPUT: SOI records that where the medio de payment is Payment Credito the system issues ONE RETURN NUMBER PER ADMINISTRADORA contained in the settlement, whereas an electronic payment (PSE) yields a single return number. The engine's reconciliation must therefore expect either one or many return numbers back for the same run. See E10.

fields.Position (Start-End): Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
fields.Field Explanation: Optional free-text label. Both operator manuals mark it optional. Use it to carry the run identifier so that the returned return number can be tied back to the payroll run without relying on the portal's own chronology.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Indicador de fondo unico para todos los empleados y fondo seleccionado
fields.Conditional Reason: If = Y the value of T09 (Code del Severance-savings fund) is IGNORED for every record and replaced by the single fund selected here. If = N, T09 governs. See T09, whose Conditional Reason back-references this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
fields.Field Explanation: CONDITIONAL PAIR. Simple S.A. asks 'Deseas que las severance savings de todos los employees incluidos en esta return sean enviadas a un solo severance-savings fund?'. Answering YES overwrites the per-employee fund with one value for the whole return. For a real employer the answer is almost always NO, because the fund is the EMPLOYEE'S statutory choice (Law 50 of 1990 art. 99 num. 3: 'en el fondo de cesantia que el mismo elija'). Answering YES to save keystrokes deposits other people's money into the wrong fund and does not discharge the obligation. Set to N and let T09 carry the per-employee value.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Indicador de generacion a partir de la ultima PILA
fields.Position (Start-End): Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
fields.Field Explanation: Simple S.A. offers to build the severance savings return from the contributor list of the last PILA return paid for the chosen year. Convenient and dangerous: the PILA population is the population that was PAID in a month, which is not the population ENTITLED to a severance savings deposit for the year. An employee who left during the accrual year is EXCLUDED from the deposit: the severance savings are paid directly in the final settlement (Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 4; Population Rules Step 0 exclusion (2)), so a leaver must never be added to the return - a leaver included is a double payment. All-inclusive salary employees are present in PILA but owed nothing, and the other Step 0 exclusions are not visible in a PILA list either. The engine must generate the population itself from the Population Rules and set this to N. Wage-type mapping of the two exclusions: a leaver's severance savings and interest are paid directly through wage types 62110 'Cash-out of Severance Pay' and 62117 'Cash-out of Interest Severance Pay' in the termination month or the month after, and generate no fund deposit (wage type 25827 'Payment Severance Funds Inf.'); an integral-salary employee (wage type 62140 'Integral Salary') generates no 25827 either.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Respuesta al ajuste automatico de validacion Asofondos
fields.Conditional Reason: Presented only where the validation returns at least one difference. Where the report is empty the question is not asked. Depends on T05, T06, T07 and T08, which are the values validated; each of those back-references this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
fields.Field Explanation: BOTH operators validate the surnames and names in the return against the affiliate base that ASOFONDOS delivers to the information operators ANNUALLY, and present a downloadable Excel difference report. Answering SI replaces the employer's values with the Asofondos values; answering NO keeps the employer's values. Answer NO and investigate: a mismatch is usually either a genuine misspelling in payroll master data (fix it at source, it will also be wrong on Form 220 and Format 2276) or an affiliate whose fund record is stale. Silently accepting SI hides a master-data defect that recurs every year.
fields.Option Values: -> Sheet 6: Respuesta a la validacion Asofondos

fields.Field Name (EN): Return number assigned by the operator
fields.Position (Start-End): Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
fields.Field Explanation: OUTPUT, not input. Assigned when the settlement is finalised and printed on the pre-payment voucher PDF. Store it per run - and note the cardinality trap in E05: with Payment Credito there is one number PER FONDO, so the store must be one-to-many. This number is the key for the later return recovery, the per-fund and per-affiliate reports and the audit trail that evidences compliance with the February deadline.

fields.Field Name (EN): Total value payable in the return
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Valor total a pagar de la planilla
fields.Position (Start-End): Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
fields.Field Explanation: CONTROL TOTAL. Displayed on the settlement summary and on the voucher. It must equal the sum of T14 across the detail records of the return; where the medio de payment splits the return per fondo, the sum of the per-fondo totals must equal the run total. This is the only arithmetic check the channel gives you - there is no header record in the file carrying a declared total, so a truncated upload is NOT self-detecting. Compare the returned total against the engine's own sum before paying.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos. No decimals, no thousand separators, no sign. The published layout gives amount fields 9 integer positions, right-aligned and zero-filled, with a 4-position zero filler in front of each. Round the computed liquidation to the peso - do NOT round up to the next 100 as PILA requires (Decree 1990 of 2016 art. 1 governs contributions, not the severance savings deposit), and do NOT round to the nearest 1,000 as Form 350 requires (ET art. 577). Blending the three conventions is the classic Colombian defect.

fields.Field Name (EN): ═══ detail record - identification(published layout, campos 1 to 8) ═══

fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 1-2 | XLS column not present
fields.Field Explanation: Campo mandatory, siempre debe ser 02. A CONSTANT, quoted verbatim from the published layout: every detail line of the unified severance savings file is a type-02 record. There is no type-01 header record and no trailer record in this layout - the contributor data and the period live in the portal envelope (E01 to E06), not in the file. Consequence: the file has NO declared record count and NO declared control total, so the engine must reconcile the returned return total (E11) against its own sum.

fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 3-7 | XLS column not present
fields.Field Explanation: Campo mandatory where the data are uploaded as a flat file. Must START AT 00001 and be consecutive for the remaining records. Zero-padded to 5 positions, so the layout admits at most 99,999 employees in one return. Composite Key: positions 1-7 of every line are the record key - positions 1-2 the constant '02' and positions 3-7 the sequence - and the operator's structure validation reads them first, so an off-by-one sequence rejects the whole file before any content is validated.

fields.Conditional Reason: Determines the validation applied to T04 (length, and the PEP 15-digit rule). T04 back-references this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 8-9 | XLS column A
fields.Field Explanation: ALPHABETIC two-character code, validated against the list printed in the layout: CC, CE, TI, PA, CD, SC, PE - and, in the XLS variant of the SAME manual, also PT (Permiso temporal). THIS IS NOT THE PILA CODE SET: PILA Record Tipo 2 campo 3 uses the same two-letter mnemonics but a different admitted list, and Form 220 / Format 2276 use DIAN NUMERIC document-type codes. The engine must hold one document type and three mappers. Note the SOI-documented length trap: where the document is a Special permanence permit the NUMBER (T04) must be exactly 15 digits. Source: Employee.Document_Type, held as its own master-data attribute and mapped to the severance-savings code. Where the HR master data has no document-type field and holds the identity number in document-specific fields ('Citizenship Card ID', 'Indentity Card for Foreigners', 'Identity Card', 'National ID'), the document-field to severance-savings-code mapping is maintained as a configuration table: 'Citizenship Card ID' -> CC, 'Indentity Card for Foreigners' -> CE, and 'Identity Card' and 'National ID' each mapped in the same table to the code of the published list for the document that field holds. The type must not be inferred from which identity field is populated, because more than one field, or none, may be filled for an employee.

fields.Conditional Reason: Length and content validation depend on T03 (document type); a Special permanence permit must be exactly 15 digits. T03 back-references this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 10-25 | XLS column B
fields.Field Explanation: Mandatory. RIGHT-ALIGNED, ZERO-FILLED to 16 positions - this is the only field in the layout with an explicit alignment rule and it is the one most often got wrong, because the XLS variant of the same layout takes the number LEFT-aligned with a 15-character maximum. Composite Key: together with T03 this pair is the join key for the employee across every Colombian artefact - electronic payroll NIE044/NIE045, PILA Record Tipo 2 campos 3 and 4, Form 220 casillas 24/25, Format 2276 numeral 2 - and it is also the key the operator uses to match the Asofondos affiliate base. Strip dots, commas, spaces and hyphens before padding. PERSISTENCE: stable for life except on a document-type change (TI to CC on reaching majority, PEP/PPT to CE on regularisation), which must be notified to the fund, or the deposit lands on an orphan account.

fields.Conditional Reason: Validated as a SET with T06, T07 and T08 against the Asofondos base; the answer is given once, in E09, for the whole return. E09 back-references this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 26-45 | XLS column C
fields.Field Explanation: Mandatory, supplied by the contributor. Left-aligned, space-filled to 20. Validated against the ASOFONDOS affiliate base (see E09) - a difference does not reject the file but raises a difference report the employer must answer SI or NO to. Strip accents and the special characters the operators reject; do not truncate silently, because a truncated surname produces a mismatch against the fund's record every single year.

fields.Conditional Reason: Conditional on the person having a second surname; space-filled when absent. Validated as a SET with T05, T07 and T08 against the Asofondos base - see E09, which back-references this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 46-65 | XLS column D
fields.Field Explanation: Supplied by the contributor; the published layout does NOT mark it mandatory, and the XLS variant states 'Campo Optional - Hasta 20 caracteres'. Space-fill the whole 20 positions where the person has no second surname - do NOT shift the following fields up, because the record is positional and the fund code at 106-107 would then be read out of the name.

fields.Conditional Reason: Validated as a SET with T05, T06 and T08 against the Asofondos base - see E09, which back-references this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 66-85 | XLS column E
fields.Field Explanation: Mandatory, supplied by the contributor. Left-aligned, space-filled to 20. Both operators note that names are pre-loaded automatically from the Asofondos base held in their systems and are editable - which means the portal may DISPLAY a name the employer never sent.

fields.Conditional Reason: Conditional on the person having a second name; space-filled when absent. Validated as a SET with T05, T06 and T07 against the Asofondos base - see E09, which back-references this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 86-105 | XLS column F
fields.Field Explanation: Supplied by the contributor; not marked mandatory, and the XLS variant states 'Campo Optional'. Maps to the Data-Dictionary Other_Names field, which is the same field that feeds electronic payroll OtrosNombres and Form 220 - keep one source of truth.

fields.Field Name (EN): ═══ detail record - fund, days and amounts(published layout, campos 9 to 14) ═══
Severance-savings fund code of the affiliate
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Codigo del Fondo de Cesantias al que pertenece el afiliado
fields.Conditional Reason: IGNORED where E07 (single-fund indicator) = Y, in which case the return-level fund overwrites this value for every record. E07 back-references this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 106-107 | XLS column G
fields.Field Explanation: Campo mandatory, validated against the funds registered in the operator's system. The published layout admits exactly FIVE values and prints them: 02 Proteccion, 03 Porvenir, 10 Colfondos, 15 Fondo Nacional del Ahorro (FNA), 19 Old Mutual (antes Skandia). STALE LABEL, LIVE CODE: code 19's printed label is out of date - the entity trades as Skandia again (Skandia Pension fund administrator y Severance savings S.A., authorised by the Financial Superintendence in January 2025 as SKANDIA AFP-ACCAI S.A. under Law 2381 of 2024). Send the CODE, not the name. The fund is the EMPLOYEE'S choice under Law 50 of 1990 art. 99 num. 3 and is master data on the employee, not a company default. Source: Master Data field 'Severance Fund Name', which holds the fund as a NAME and not as the 2-digit operator code; the fund name to code mapping is maintained as a configuration table, with every spelling in use for a fund mapped to one of the five codes. Per Population Rules an empty fund must be escalated, never defaulted. Fund presence must not be used to select the population: an integral-salary employee may also carry a fund name and is still excluded.

fields.Conditional Reason: Feeds the auto-calculation of T14 together with T12; the layout's formula is basic salary * (dias worked / 360). T12 and T14 back-reference this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 108-110 | XLS column H
fields.Field Explanation: Mandatory. Admits values from 1 to 360 - a 360-DAY COMMERCIAL YEAR, rather than 365. A full year of service is 360, and every partial year is the actual days of service counted on the commercial convention (each month 30 days). Include the days of paid leave and of employer-paid or institution-paid incapacity, which count as service. The 3-position field cannot carry more than one year, which is the layout's way of saying that this filing is strictly one accrual year per record. SOURCE AND EXCLUSIONS: per Population Rules Step 1, count the accrual-year days of service on the 30-day convention from the later of 1 January and the current-contract hire date to the earlier of 31 December and the leaving date, EXCLUDING unpaid leave and suspensions. Wage-type mapping: the payroll counter is wage type 68029 'Days worked current year (Without Leaves)' in the December period (360 for a full year); use it only as a reconciliation check, not as the source, because it does not count a hire made late in December and, for a hire early in the accrual year, can differ from the commercial-year count from the hire date (the interest wage type 62127 uses the commercial count). Reconciliation: the December balance 68028 'Balance Cesantias' equals 'ces base' 68040 x 68029 / 360 where no in-year direct payment (62110 'Cash-out of Severance Pay') was made.

fields.Field Name (EN): Zero filler before the salary field
fields.Conditional Reason: Immediately precedes T12 and is part of its 13-position amount frame; T12 back-references this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 111-114 | XLS column not present
fields.Field Explanation: Mandatory - 'Debe contener ceros'. A four-position filler that exists only in the fixed-width variant; the XLS layout has no equivalent column. Read it together with campo 14's note, which explains the intent: 'antes de cada value deben ir 4 espacios (pueden ser rellenos con ceros o en blanco)'. In other words the two amount fields are really 13 positions each, of which the leading 4 must be zeros or blanks. Write ZEROS, not blanks - the campo-11 rule is categorical where the campo-14 note is permissive, and zeros satisfy both.

fields.Field Name (EN): Basic salary reported in the last month
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Salario basico reportado en el ultimo mes
fields.Conditional Reason: Framed by the T11 zero filler and feeds the auto-calculation of T14 with T10. T11 and T14 back-reference this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 115-123 | XLS column I
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Contractual_Salary (December of the accrual year) [WTC: CO-SALARIO-BASICO]
fields.Field Explanation: SCOPE: the amount is owned by the Wage Type Catalogue, not the Data Dictionary - the scope rule routes 'Base Salary / Basic Salary amounts -> WTC, NOT DD'. The 'Payroll.' prefix marks it as outside DD master data; it is a standing contract attribute, not a per-run computation. Column E is therefore N and the Data Dictionary holds no Contractual Salary field. Mandatory. Nine integers, no decimals, no commas, no points, not less than zero. The layout is explicit about WHICH salary: 'el ultimo basic salary reportado en el mes de diciembre del ano accrued de severance savings'. THIS IS THE OPERATOR'S REPORTING FIELD, NOT THE STATUTORY BASE. CST art. 253 fixes the statutory base as the last monthly salary provided it has not varied in the last three months, otherwise the average of the last year of service (or of the whole period if shorter), INCLUDING the transport allowance. The field name says 'basico' and the operator's calculator uses it alone - see the trap documented at T14. Report the December basic here and compute T14 yourself. Source: wage type 63807 'Basic Salary Base Amount' in the December period of the accrual year (the full contractual monthly salary). Do NOT use wage type 62100 'Ordinary Salary', which is the amount actually paid in the month, prorated for absences, and is therefore equal to or lower than 63807, never higher. The Master Data field 'Basic Salary' is a snapshot of the month the report is run and is valid for T12 only when taken for December.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos. No decimals, no thousand separators, no sign. The published layout gives amount fields 9 integer positions, right-aligned and zero-filled, with a 4-position zero filler in front of each. Round the computed liquidation to the peso - do NOT round up to the next 100 as PILA requires (Decree 1990 of 2016 art. 1 governs contributions, not the severance savings deposit), and do NOT round to the nearest 1,000 as Form 350 requires (ET art. 577). Blending the three conventions is the classic Colombian defect.

fields.Field Name (EN): Zero filler before the severance-savings value
fields.Conditional Reason: Immediately precedes T14 and is part of its 13-position amount frame; T14 back-references this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 124-127 | XLS column not present
fields.Field Explanation: Mandatory - 'Debe contener ceros'. The second four-position filler, framing the amount at 128-136 exactly as T11 frames the amount at 115-123. Absent from the XLS layout. Write zeros.

fields.Field Name (EN): Value of the severance savings deposited
fields.Conditional Reason: Framed by the T13 zero filler; auto-calculated from T10 and T12 if left blank, which must never be allowed. T10, T12 and T13 back-reference this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 128-136 | XLS column J
fields.Field Explanation: Mandatory, nine integers. TWO RULES AND ONE TRAP. Rule one, the floor: 'el value minimo del collection debe ser de un (1) dia de un (1) SMLMV del ano accrued' - for accrual year 2026 one day of the SMMLV of COP 1,750,905 is COP 58,363.50, so a record below that is rejected. Rule two, the override: the layout's own formula is basic salary * (dias worked / 360) BUT 'en este campo el contributor puede especificar un value diferente y no se haran calculos automaticos de este value'. THE TRAP: the operator's formula omits the TRANSPORT ALLOWANCE, which CST art. 253 requires in the base. For an employee on the 2026 minimum wage the operator would compute 1,750,905 while the statute requires (1,750,905 + 249,095) = 2,000,000 - a shortfall of COP 249,095 that is a SHORT DEPOSIT, penalised at one day's salary for every day of delay under Law 50 of 1990 art. 99 num. 3, uncapped. ALWAYS write the engine's own figure into this field and never rely on the portal calculator. Where the monthly advance regime of MA01 is in use, this field carries the CONSOLIDATED annual figure and only the difference computed at MA05 is actually deposited in February. WHAT IS DEPOSITED - NET OF DIRECT PAYMENTS ALREADY MADE: T14 carries the amount actually deposited for the employee = the consolidated 31 December balance (IN01) LESS the lawful partial payments already made directly to the employee during the accrual year (CST art. 254; Population Rules Step 1 (f)) and LESS any direct payment of that balance made in January to an employee who left before the deposit, which is lawful under Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 4. An employee who left and was paid in full in the final settlement is not in the return at all (Population Rules Step 0 exclusion (2)). Keep the gross annual liquidation as a separate engine value: System Mapping 'Cesantias_Annual_Liquidation' is the gross figure, T14 is the net deposit. Wage-type mapping: the February fund deposit is wage type 25827 / 65805 'Payment Severance Funds Inf.'. The consolidated 31 December balance is the absolute value of wage type 63814 'Severance Balance (Current Month)' in the January period; it is the annual liquidation ('ces base' 68040 x days / 360) less the in-year direct payments 62110 'Cash-out of Severance Pay' (paired with 62117 'Cash-out of Interest Severance Pay' for the interest). A January direct payment of part of that balance is wage type 62126 'Advance Severance Last Year', and the deposit then carries the remainder: 25827 (February) + 62126 (January) = |63814| (January). The engine does NOT generate a direct payment of the consolidated balance to an employee who remains in service: CST art. 254 prohibits it except for the authorised housing and education purposes, so the only direct payments that reduce T14 for an active employee are those lawful partial payments; any other request to pay the consolidated balance directly to an active employee is rejected, and the balance is deposited in full. A full direct payment with fehaciente evidence is handled through E92. Where the remainder after direct payments falls below the one-day SMMLV floor the channel rejects the record and the residue is settled with the employee (Population Rules Step 0 exclusion (5)). The base 68040 exceeds the December basic salary 63807 wherever variable pay is averaged under CST art. 253, which is why T14 must never be left to the operator's basic-salary formula.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos. No decimals, no thousand separators, no sign. The published layout gives amount fields 9 integer positions, right-aligned and zero-filled, with a 4-position zero filler in front of each. Round the computed liquidation to the peso - do NOT round up to the next 100 as PILA requires (Decree 1990 of 2016 art. 1 governs contributions, not the severance savings deposit), and do NOT round to the nearest 1,000 as Form 350 requires (ET art. 577). Blending the three conventions is the classic Colombian defect.

fields.Field Name (EN): ═══ detail record - affiliate contact data(published layout, campos 15 to 20) ═══

fields.Conditional Reason: Should be consistent with T16 and T17 (the DANE department and municipality of the same address); those two fields back-reference this one.
fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 137-186 | XLS column K
fields.Field Explanation: The employee's residential address, 50 positions, left-aligned and space-filled. This is the AFFILIATE'S address for the fund's own statutory communications with its member, which is why the layout asks for the residence and not the work address - contrast electronic payroll and PILA, which carry the WORK municipality. Do not send the work address; the fund will post the member's statements to it. Composite Key: the affiliate's domicile is carried across THREE fields that must describe one place - T15 the free-text street address, T16 the two-digit DANE department and T17 the three-digit DANE municipality. Within T15 itself, Colombian addresses decompose as via type (CALLE / CARRERA / DIAGONAL / TRANSVERSAL), via number, the NO separator, the cross-via number, the hyphen, the door number and any complement (APTO / TORRE / INT). Abbreviate by a documented rule where the whole exceeds 50 positions - never cut mid-token, because the fund cannot repair a truncated address. Source: Master Data fields 'Address Line 1' and 'Address Line 2' hold the residential address; concatenate Line 1 + space + Line 2 before applying the 50-position rule. Do not use 'Work location' or 'Personal Subarea', which are work places. A residence abroad (Master Data field 'Country' other than CO) has no DANE department or municipality code.

fields.Conditional Reason: Must be the department half of the same DANE divipola code whose municipality half is T17, and must correspond to the address in T15. T15 and T17 back-reference this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 187-188 | XLS column L
fields.Field Explanation: Two positions, per the DANE list. The DANE divipola code is hierarchical: the two-digit department prefix plus the three-digit municipality suffix form the five-digit municipality code (11 + 001 = 11001, Bogota D.C.). Composite Key: T16 and T17 must be written as the two halves of ONE divipola code, never picked from two different lists. Source: Master Data field 'Employee Address - Department', which holds a 3-letter alphabetic abbreviation (DC, ANT, CUN, VAC, ATL, CAL, QUI, RIS, NAR, NSA, MAG, TOL, BOL, SAN, BOY), not the 2-digit DANE code. The abbreviation to DANE department code mapping is maintained as a configuration table with one entry per abbreviation in use (DC -> 11, ANT -> 05, VAC -> 76, ATL -> 08, per the DANE divipola list - see Field Options). Foreign provinces (abbreviations such as ON, VD, JAL) have no DANE code.

fields.Conditional Reason: Must be the municipality half of the same DANE divipola code whose department half is T16, and must correspond to the address in T15. T15 and T16 back-reference this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 189-191 | XLS column M
fields.Field Explanation: Three positions, per the DANE list, and it is the SUFFIX only - not the five-digit code. Writing the full 11001 into a three-position field truncates to 110 and silently relocates the affiliate. Composite Key: see T16. Source: no municipality code exists in master data. The Master Data field 'City' is free text, with several spellings for the same municipality (Bogota / BOGOTA / Bogota D.C. / Santafe de Bogota D.C.; Medellin / MEDELLIN), values that are a neighbourhood or a department rather than a municipality, and foreign cities. Capture the DANE divipola municipality code as a coded master-data field; free-text matching is not reliable.

fields.Conditional Reason: Conditional on a 7-digit landline being held for the employee; filled with spaces or zeros where only a mobile number exists. Paired in the layout with T19 as the affiliate's contact block; T19 back-references this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 192-198 | XLS column N
fields.Field Explanation: 'Solo admite 7 numeros' - exactly seven digits, so the field cannot carry a mobile number (10 digits in Colombia) nor a number written with the area code. Where only a mobile is held, the field must be zero- or space-filled rather than truncated; a truncated mobile is a wrong-number record on the fund's affiliate file. Source: Master Data field 'Phone number', which holds one undifferentiated number per employee with no landline/mobile type, normally a country-code-prefixed mobile of 12 digits. Unless a separate landline is captured, this field is zero-filled; never derive it by truncating the stored number.

fields.Conditional Reason: Conditional on an e-mail being held. Paired in the layout with T18 as the affiliate's contact block; T18 back-references this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 199-248 | XLS column O
fields.Field Explanation: Fifty positions. The layout prints its own validation: letters A-Z, digits 0-9, hyphen, underscore, apostrophe and full stop are admitted in the local part; the @ is the mandatory indicator; the domain may contain only letters, digits and the hyphen, and the hyphen may be neither the first nor the last character of the domain. Composite Key: local-part + '@' + domain; the operator validates the three parts separately, so an address that merely 'looks' valid can still be rejected on the domain rule.

fields.Position (Start-End): TXT positions 249-258 | XLS column P
fields.Field Explanation: Format AAAA-MM-DD, ten positions INCLUDING the two hyphens - note that the published layout types this field N while its content is not purely numeric, so a strict numeric writer would emit 20190301 and shift nothing (the field is last) but would still fail the format validation. Composite Key: positions 249-252 year, 253 hyphen, 254-255 month, 256 hyphen, 257-258 day. THIS IS THE HIRE DATE OF THE CONTRACT, NOT THE START OF THE ACCRUAL PERIOD: for an employee hired in 2019 and reported for accrual year 2026 the value is still 2019-03-01, while T10 carries 360 days. Sending the 1 January of the accrual year here is a common defect and it corrupts the fund's seniority record. Source: Master Data field 'Hire Date' (DD-MM-YYYY, converted to AAAA-MM-DD), which is the hire date of the CURRENT contract per Population Rules ('for a rehired employee, use the hire date of the CURRENT contract'). Do not use 'Adjusted Service Date' (YYYY-MM-DD, a recognised-seniority date) or 'Original Hire Date' (DD-MM-YYYY, the first hire date of a rehired employee), both of which can differ from the current-contract hire date.

Written agreement for the monthly advance deposit
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Acuerdo escrito para la consignacion mensual anticipada
fields.Record Type / Section: Simplified Labour Regime -- not a file field
fields.Conditional Reason: Gates every other MA field: where this is N, MA02 to MA05 are not produced and the ordinary annual detail record (campos 1 to 20 of the published layout) is the only route. MA02, MA03, MA04 and MA05 each back-reference this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): Not in any published layout - engine-held configuration
fields.Field Explanation: Law 2466 of 2025 art. 64 added para. 1 to Law 50 of 1990 art. 99 permitting the employer to deposit monthly, to the severance savings fund, 8.33% of the base. The statute grants the option to the EMPLOYER ('El employer podra aportar mensualmente'); the MinTrabajo draft decree additionally requires the employee's agreement - draft art. 4 para. 2: 'constituye un mecanismo voluntario que podra ser adoptado por el employer previo acuerdo con el employee, sin que sustituya el regimen legal de consignacion annual'. Hold the flag per contract, not per company. The MinTrabajo draft decree amending Decree 1072 of 2015 (proyecto_decreto_cesantias_2026.pdf) is not in force. Build the field and keep the feature switched OFF until the decree is published AND the MinSalud PILA regulation exists.

fields.Record Type / Section: Simplified Labour Regime -- not a file field
fields.Conditional Reason: Produced only where MA01 = Y, that is only where a written monthly-advance agreement exists. Feeds MA03, which is 8.33% of this value, and is reconciled at year end against the statutory annual base through MA05. MA01, MA03 and MA05 back-reference this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): Not in any published layout - no PILA field exists until MinSalud issues the regulation under Law 2466 of 2025 art. 64 para. 1
fields.Field Explanation: Law 2466 art. 64 para. 1 defines the base VERBATIM as 'el salary base de liquidacion compuesto por el salary monthly sumado al transport allowance en los casos en que a este hubiere lugar'. So, unlike the operator's annual calculator (see T14), the STATUTE for the monthly advance includes the transport allowance expressly. The draft decree adds the variable-salary rule: 'la consignacion monthly anticipada correspondera al 8,33% de lo earning por el employee en el respectivo mes, adicionado con el transport allowance cuando haya lugar'. The MinTrabajo draft decree amending Decree 1072 of 2015 (proyecto_decreto_cesantias_2026.pdf) is not in force. Build the field and keep the feature switched OFF until the decree is published AND the MinSalud PILA regulation exists.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos. No decimals, no thousand separators, no sign. The published layout gives amount fields 9 integer positions, right-aligned and zero-filled, with a 4-position zero filler in front of each. Round the computed liquidation to the peso - do NOT round up to the next 100 as PILA requires (Decree 1990 of 2016 art. 1 governs contributions, not the severance savings deposit), and do NOT round to the nearest 1,000 as Form 350 requires (ET art. 577). Blending the three conventions is the classic Colombian defect.

fields.Record Type / Section: Simplified Labour Regime -- not a file field
fields.Conditional Reason: Produced only where MA01 = Y and computed from MA02. MA01 and MA02 back-reference this field; MA05 consumes the accumulated total.
fields.Position (Start-End): Not in any published layout - no PILA field exists until MinSalud issues the regulation under Law 2466 of 2025 art. 64 para. 1
fields.Field Explanation: 8.33% of MA02. Note that 8.33% is an APPROXIMATION of one twelfth (8.3333...%), so twelve monthly advances do NOT reconcile exactly to one twelfth-based annual liquidation: on a 2,000,000 base, 12 x 166,600 = 1,999,200 against an annual entitlement of 2,000,000, a shortfall of 800 pesos. The statute fixes the rate at 8.33% and the draft decree requires the year-end consolidation to absorb the difference (see MA05) - so the residual is expected and must be paid, not written off. The MinTrabajo draft decree amending Decree 1072 of 2015 (proyecto_decreto_cesantias_2026.pdf) is not in force. Build the field and keep the feature switched OFF until the decree is published AND the MinSalud PILA regulation exists.

fields.Field Name (EN): PILA contribution type for the cesantias advance
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Tipo de cotizacion PILA para la consignacion anticipada
fields.Record Type / Section: Simplified Labour Regime -- not a file field
fields.Conditional Reason: Produced only where MA01 = Y. Depends on a MinSalud regulation that does not yet exist. MA01 back-references this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): PILA - no position exists; MinSalud has not issued the contribution-type regulation under Law 2466 of 2025 art. 64 para. 1
fields.Format: Numeric contribution-type code; no width is published
fields.Field Explanation: THE CHANNEL FOR THE MONTHLY ADVANCE IS NOT THIS FILING - IT IS PILA. Law 2466 art. 64 para. 1 instructs MinSalud to regulate the PILA accordingly, and the draft decree makes the point twice: the advance is paid 'exclusivamente a traves de la Integrated Contribution Settlement Return (PILA) -PILA-' (draft art. 4 para. 3) and 'debera reportarse en la PILA como contributions al sistema de severance savings mediante el tipo de contribution que defina el Ministry of Health and Social Protection' (draft art. 1 para. 2). The same paragraph gives MinSalud SIX MONTHS from the decree's entry into force to adjust PILA, and the funds and information operators a FURTHER SIX MONTHS from that regulation to build. While the decree remains a draft and no PILA contribution type exists, the feature cannot be switched on and the annual return remains the only lawful route. The MinTrabajo draft decree amending Decree 1072 of 2015 (proyecto_decreto_cesantias_2026.pdf) is not in force. Build the field and keep the feature switched OFF until the decree is published AND the MinSalud PILA regulation exists.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Consolidacion definitiva y ajustes al cierre anual
fields.Record Type / Section: Simplified Labour Regime -- not a file field
fields.Conditional Reason: Produced only where MA01 = Y; it is the reconciling item between the sum of MA03, whose base is MA02, and the statutory annual liquidation in T14. MA01, MA02 and MA03 back-reference this field; T14 carries the consolidated figure.
fields.Position (Start-End): Feeds T14 of the annual planilla
fields.Field Explanation: THE MONTHLY ADVANCE DOES NOT REPLACE THE ANNUAL LIQUIDATION. Draft art. 1 para. 1 is categorical: 'al cierre del respectivo period annual, el employer debera efectuar la consolidacion definitiva del auxilio de cesantia con base en el promedio de lo earning en el ultimo ano de service ... y realizar los ajustes a que haya lugar. Lo anterior sin que ello implique payment anticipado, parcial o fraccionado del auxilio de cesantia, el cual se entendera consolidado unicamente al cierre del respectivo period annual'. And draft art. 4 para. 4 preserves the deadline while relaxing the monthly rhythm: 'La omision de uno o varios payments mensuales no configurara mora, siempre que se complete el value total annual a mas tardar el 14 February del ano siguiente, configurandose la mora a partir del 15 February'. So the engine must still run the annual liquidation, compare it with the sum of the advances, and deposit the difference by the February deadline. The MinTrabajo draft decree amending Decree 1072 of 2015 (proyecto_decreto_cesantias_2026.pdf) is not in force. Build the field and keep the feature switched OFF until the decree is published AND the MinSalud PILA regulation exists.

fields.Field Name (EN): ═══ interest on severance savings - paid to the employee, never to the fund ═══

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Saldo de cesantias al 31 de diciembre
fields.Record Type / Section: Severance-Savings Interest -- not a file field
fields.Conditional Reason: Not conditional. Feeds IN02 and IN03.
fields.Position (Start-End): NOT in this filing - engine output, reported to the employee
fields.Field Explanation: The balance in the employee's favour at 31 December, or at the date of definitive withdrawal or partial settlement. It is the base of the Law 52 of 1975 art. 1 interest. Deliberately shown on this Spec as a NOT-APPLICABLE row: it is not a field of the severance savings return, but it is computed from the same liquidation and the two are routinely confused. Source: the consolidated 31 December balance is the absolute value of wage type 63814 'Severance Balance (Current Month)' in the January period of the following year (negative sign = liability); it equals the February deposit 25827 plus any January direct advance 62126 and is already net of in-year direct payments (62110). The December value of wage type 68028 'Balance Cesantias' is a reconciliation check, not the source; wage type 64999 'Total Balance Cesantias' is NOT this balance.

fields.Field Name (EN): Annual interest on severance savings at 12%
fields.Record Type / Section: Severance-Savings Interest -- not a file field
fields.Conditional Reason: Not conditional. Computed from IN01. IN03 is the monthly alternative to this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): NOT in this filing - paid directly to the employee
fields.Field Explanation: 12% per annum on the IN01 balance, pro-rated on days over 360. PAID TO THE EMPLOYEE DIRECTLY, IN THE MONTH OF JANUARY of the following year - not to the fund, and not in February. The two obligations have different payees, different deadlines and different penalties: failure to deposit the principal costs one day's salary per day of delay, whereas failure to pay the interest costs an indemnity equal to the interest owed, ONCE ONLY (Law 52 of 1975 art. 1). The draft decree would add a further precision at art. 4: the interest is 'entregado directamente al employee dentro del mes siguiente a la fecha de liquidacion del auxilio de cesantia'. No interest on interest may be liquidated. Source: paid in the January payroll as wage type 62127 'Advance Interest Severance Pay', equal to round(12% x IN01 x days / 360) to the peso. Do not use wage type 63815 'Interests Balance (Current Month)' at December as the payable amount: it is computed on the liquidation before direct payments and is not the amount paid.

fields.Record Type / Section: Severance-Savings Interest -- not a file field
fields.Conditional Reason: Available only where a WRITTEN agreement exists between employer and employee; it replaces the January payment of IN02 with twelve monthly payments. IN02 back-references this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): NOT in this filing - paid directly to the employee
fields.Field Explanation: Law 2466 of 2025 art. 64 para. 2, verbatim: 'Las partes podran acordar por escrito la mensualizacion de los intereses sobre las severance savings, pagando al employee el 1% del salary base de liquidacion compuesto por el salary monthly sumado al transport allowance en los casos en que a este hubiere lugar'. Three engine consequences. First, it needs a written agreement, so the flag is per contract. Second, the base is the SAME monthly base as MA02 (salary + transport allowance), not the accumulated balance - so the monthly route and the annual route give different figures and the draft decree confirms the 1% monthly 'correspondiente al doce por ciento (12%) annual previsto en la Law'. Third, the draft decree sets the payment window: 'dentro del mes calendario siguiente al de su causacion'. The MinTrabajo draft decree amending Decree 1072 of 2015 (proyecto_decreto_cesantias_2026.pdf) is not in force. Build the field and keep the feature switched OFF until the decree is published AND the MinSalud PILA regulation exists.

fields.Field Name (EN): ═══ inbound - deposit confirmation and compliance evidence(co-in-cesantias-confirmation) ═══

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Fecha de pago de la planilla
fields.Position (Start-End): Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
fields.Field Explanation: INBOUND. The date the return was actually PAID, which is the date that matters for the deadline - not the date the return was built. Both operators separate settlement from payment: the return is liquidated, a pre-payment voucher is issued, and payment then follows by PSE or by credit. A return liquidated on 13 February and paid on 17 February is LATE. Store the payment date, not the liquidation date, as the compliance evidence. Composite Key: AAAA-MM-DD - positions 1-4 the year, 5 the hyphen, 6-7 the month, 8 the hyphen, 9-10 the day; the same 10-character date frame as T20, and the pair (E10 return number, E90 payment date) is the key of the compliance evidence held per accrual year.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Estado de cumplimiento de la consignacion por empleado
fields.Position (Start-End): Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
fields.Field Explanation: INBOUND / DERIVED. Per employee and per accrual year, one of ON TIME, LATE (with the day count), SHORT (with the shortfall) or DISCHARGED BY DIRECT PAYMENT. This is the field that quantifies the exposure, because the Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 3 penalty is one day's salary for EACH DAY of delay, PER EMPLOYEE, and uncapped - on 100 minimum-wage employees a fortnight's delay is of the order of COP 81.7 million. Recompute it from E90 against the deadline in the Report Matrix, and hold it for the employee's three-year limitation period (CST art. 488 as substituted by Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 62). Where E92 records a discharge by proven direct payment, set this field to DISCHARGED BY DIRECT PAYMENT instead of deriving it from E90 - see E92.

fields.Conditional Reason: Where = Y, no annual detail record is produced for that employee (campos 1 to 20 of the published layout are not written) and E91 is set to DISCHARGED BY DIRECT PAYMENT. E91 back-references this field.
fields.Position (Start-End): Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
fields.Field Explanation: CST art. 57 para. 4, added by Law 2466 of 2025 art. 15, verbatim: 'Cuando el employer acredite de manera fehaciente el payment directo al employee del value correspondiente a las severance savings, dicho payment se considerara liberatorio de la obligacion, y no procedera sancion por no consignacion, salvo que se demuestre que el payment no se realizo en condiciones de libertad y que no fue utilizado en fines autorizados por la Law. No obstante, la afiliacion a Severance-savings fund es mandatory.' Three limits the engine must respect: the discharge needs FEHACIENTE evidence, it is rebuttable on the freedom-and-purpose test, and it does NOT remove the duty to affiliate the employee to a fund. A DRAFTING NOTE on the citation: art. 15's enacting formula announces only 'los paragrafos 2 y 3' of CST art. 57, yet the published text prints a Paragrafo 4 and this is it - so cite CST art. 57 para. 4 as added by Law 2466 of 2025 art. 15, and expect the discrepancy to be raised. Wage-type mapping of direct payments: during the year, wage type 62110 'Cash-out of Severance Pay'; in January, wage type 62126 'Advance Severance Last Year'; the fund deposit, wage type 25827, then carries the remainder of the balance. This flag covers a FULL discharge of the deposit obligation by proven direct payment (Population Rules Step 0 exclusion (4)). An employee who left and was paid directly in the final settlement is NOT an E92 case but a Step 0 exclusion (2) under Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 4, and a January direct payment to an employee who left before the deposit is treated as that lawful payment. A partial direct payment does not set E92 = Y: T14 carries the deposit net of the direct payments already made and the record is still produced. The engine does not generate a direct payment of the consolidated balance to an employee who remains in service except for the housing and education purposes authorised by CST art. 254; such lawful partial payments reduce T14, and any other direct payment to an active employee is rejected. E92 = Y only for a full discharge with fehaciente evidence (see T14).

fields.Position (Start-End): Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
fields.Field Explanation: INBOUND. Both operators issue reports after payment - por fondo, por affiliate and a consolidated informe completo, in PDF or Excel - and the fund itself issues the deposit certificate. CCG Module 10 records that the certificate is issued by the FUND but the EMPLOYER must be able to evidence it. Store the reference against E10 and E90; it is the primary evidence in a claim, and the employee's claim period runs three years.
